cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop is shut, but you leave when I release you. A counted till is not a completed close.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it twice. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Counting checks the cash; reconciliation checks the record. Bring her in while I finish, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's in our taxi now. The driver wants to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on speaker. I'll give him your departure time once I've signed you off. Please stop checking with people who can't dismiss you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 counted-versus-completed and A3 reconciliation correction make A the qualified release authority; A5 demands control of the taxi conversation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 counting twice does not complete A3 record check; B4 daughter moving into a taxi does not imply B has left.

relationship.evidence: B2 family obligation and B4 waiting driver are credible immediate concerns that each alter A response.

heightening.evidence: B4 driver impatience causes A5 speakerphone request and sign-off deadline, extending the dismissal claim outside the shop.

specificity.evidence: A1 shut shop and unfinished close plus B2 waiting daughter establish concrete departure stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 now corrects the work and offers accommodation; A5 asks for control with one strained admonition.
